content: It specifically quantifies the major NRL allergens, including Hev b 1, Hev b 3, Hev b 5, and Hev b 6.02. The test operates on the principle of an enzyme immunometric assay, utilizing highly specific monoclonal antibodies that target clinically significant latex allergens found in NRL products. Scientifically, FITkit is also referred to as an Enzyme Immunoassay (EIA) or Immuno-Enzymometric Assay (IEMA). FITkit is a proprietary product developed and trademarked by Quattromed Ltd.
